about.en: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. is a US mechanical and electrical contracting company listed on the NYSE. Its mechanical segment installs and services heating, ventilation and air conditioning, plumbing, piping and controls, along with off-site modular construction and fire protection, and its electrical segment serves commercial, industrial and institutional buildings including data centers. In tokenized and derivative markets, FIX is the reference equity for products tracking Comfort Systems USA shares.
